selection.providerInstruction: Every Training Funding Approval brief returns definition-selection with definitionKey training-funding-approval, generatedInterpretation null and businessParameters null. The reviewed local demo lets an employee create and edit drafts, submit, revise returned records and resubmit the same record; one manager approves or returns with a required reason, and finance reads and audits. A decision records local funding approval only: it does not execute payment or reimbursement, enroll an employee in a course, provide calendar delivery, verify an entitlement, or create a private identity boundary. Omitted routine pages and presentation accept supported-default with zero questions. Explicit or ambiguous requester-only or private records, real identity, SSO, tenant isolation, thresholds, budgets, multiple or sequential reviewers, editing submitted or approved records, reopening approved records, configurable reason policy, changed fields or requiredness, currency codes, symbols, conversion or precision, payment, reimbursement execution, enrollment, calendar delivery, entitlement verification, external identity, HR, accounting or notification delivery require needs-clarification. Preserve every independent material question using authorization, visibility, role, business-rule, data or integration. Follow-ups retain every still-required exclusion until the user explicitly accepts supported scope; never infer acceptance or hide requirements in identity text. Fee is a required local funding amount greater than zero without an invented currency code, symbol, scale or payment behavior. The exact roles are selectable local demo roles with role-wide reads. selection.providerInstruction: Every Equipment Procurement Approval brief returns definition-selection with definitionKey equipment-procurement-approval, generatedInterpretation null and businessParameters null. The reviewed local demo handles one equipment item per request: item name, a required positive integer quantity, a required positive estimated unit price, an exact server-calculated quantity-times-unit-price total and a required justification. Employee creates and edits drafts, submits, corrects both quantity and unit price on returned records, saves the recalculated total and resubmits the same record. One manager approves or returns with a required reason. Finance reads and audits without mutating requests. The total is always server-owned and read-only; never request or accept a caller-entered total. Omitted routine pages and presentation accept supported-default with zero questions. Explicit or ambiguous zero-cost or free equipment, zero or fractional quantity, multiple line items, tax, discount, rounding, currency codes, symbols, scale, conversion, payment, reimbursement, supplier or vendor ordering, inventory tracking, stock changes, inventory reservation, private or requester-only records, real identity, SSO, tenant isolation, thresholds, budgets, multiple or sequential reviewers, editing submitted or approved records, reopening approved records, configurable reason policy, changed fields or requiredness, procurement systems, accounting or notification delivery require needs-clarification. Preserve every independent material question using authorization, visibility, role, business-rule, data or integration. Follow-ups retain every still-required exclusion until the user explicitly accepts the supported scope; never infer acceptance. The estimate uses consistent unspecified units without currency symbols, minor-unit rounding or settlement. The exact roles are selectable local demo roles with role-wide reads.
